description: The first family-F24 arm (DECISIONS.md 9.142): the F23 run stack on a demand whose destination choice is constrained at BOTH ends, on circuity factors measured on the network that actually runs, and on a controler whose per-iteration cost has been profiled rather than assumed. What the arm must answer, in order. (1) Does the corridor's CBD end now receive the arrivals its own attraction states, and do light rail (-66.1% at the F23 gate) and heavy rail (+193.2%) move on it - the two modes whose deficits 9.136 and 9.139 traced to a corridor holding two thirds of its observed attraction (#30, #98, #84)? (2) Does taxi read HIGHER than F23's +76.6% now that a refused taxi trip keeps taxi in plan memory instead of becoming a walk (#113, 9.141) - a rise here is the repair working, not a regression. (3) Where do walk (-27.2%) and car (+14.8%) settle once the short-trip mass is drawn against balanced arrivals, and does the seesaw of 9.139 stop overshooting? (4) Does bike (+111.2%) keep falling under the stress channel, and does ride (-40.1%) move at all - its ceiling is the demand's binding, and 9.142 measured that 46,345 bound trips never reach plan memory as a ride alternative, so a flat reading here is evidence for that class and not for the pairing rule. (5) The awaiting-run measurements the issues name: the motorbike carve at its identity (#93), the leaf stand-aside log (#96), the ferry's near-wharf split (#94), the choice-set survival by mode (#96), income's effect on the fare (#108), bike stress by traffic band (#107), the counts at the freight tier (#82), and the progress digest's disk read under the incremental log reader (#131). It is also the first live test of the verdict-keyed gate watcher (#112). S2 x WEEKDAY at 25%, 300 iterations, innovation off at 240, gated per mode at 100 / 200 / 300 under the loop in GOAL.md, with the runner's own watcher stopping the hard bar itself (9.137). 25% is the standing directive (user, 1 Sep) and the 9.129 bucket rule keeps shared pairs at any fraction that is a multiple of 0.05. Graph rendering is OFF: 9.59 declared RUN.controler.create_graphs for exactly this, the F23 arm paid 3-7 s an iteration for eight PNGs it never read, and the field is wall time and disk only, never the model. NEVER compare this arm with any run before the F24 boundary: the demand (balanced destinations, re-measured circuity), the plans and the compiled controler are all part of a run's identity (9.127, 9.138, 9.142). NOTHING THIS PRODUCES IS A RESULT until it carries _run.json and a relaxed reading.
